profile_text.body:
ResearchRabbit is an AI-powered research discovery tool designed to help academics and researchers conduct literature reviews more efficiently. The platform allows users to find related academic papers, build citation maps, and track research trends, with the goal of reducing the time spent on manual literature searches. According to the site, the tool analyzes bibliographies, citations, and co-author relationships to surface related articles, and its algorithm refines recommendations as users select papers, learning their interests over time.

The product is described by users at Sam Houston State University as helping researchers visualize connections between existing research and streamline the discovery of related work, with the potential to reduce the burden of comprehensive literature reviews. ResearchRabbit also includes collaboration features, allowing researchers to work together within the platform.

The site's held facts list one product under the search and research category, also called ResearchRabbit, with noted capabilities including paper recommendations, collaboration features, and access to academic data. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company.
